balls.text: Steyn wants two, PK has been run out. This was fuller on middle, he slogs it away to cow corner.  Pandya swoops down on the ball and fires a flattish throw to Pollard, who does the rest. SRH bowled out for 113. The No.2 spot is within Mumbai's reach..
fullish, leg-stump line, PK comes down the track, makes room. Plays the pick-up shot over backward square leg
fuller and on the stumps, dragged to long-on
he makes room outside leg, the bowler follows him. Skewed up in the air. Short third man and backward point converge, but the ball lands in no-man's land
another of the slower balls around off from Pollard, he backs away. Throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge to the right of Parthiv, who was diving to his right
swing and a miss to a back-of-a-length slower ball outside off
low full toss on off, flat-batted to long-off.
low full toss swerves in on a leg-stump line. He falls over, the ball rolls off the pad to the off side
yorker tails in, dug out to leg side
100 up for SRH. Rohit leaps off his feet at the covers, but can only finger-tip it away. Full and outside off, slowy in pace, smacked in the air, Rohit jumps at the covers but can't pull it off
dug in shortish and outside off, slapped hard between the covers and mid-off after stepping away and making room.
shortish and outside off, flat-batted to the covers
low full toss on the pads, worked to the right of short midwicket
yorker at the base of middle and leg. Kept out

length and outside off, PK plays a defence, a la gully cricket with no back lift at all, just dabbing it down the ground. Sachin has a smile on his face. So does Tom Moody and Parthiv. I am an expert at this defence
Suchith and Pandya converge at long-off. Suchith takes it. Length and outside off, slower in pace. He is hoodwinked. Karn's bat twists in his hand as he chips it to the fielder
straight slow ball on middle, gently defended in front of the bowler
slower one on off, he is early into the shot and chips it in the air to the right of Malinga
just clears cover. Full and outside off, he plays a weak little drive over the fielder
back of a length and outside off, he kitchen-sinks it to the left of Pandya at sweeper cover. Diving save
length outside off, slapped to sweeper cover
And it continues.. Bhuvneshwar holes out for a duck! This was a length ball outside off from round the stumps, he backs away and mis-hits it to Pandya for a comfortable catch at sweeper cover
full toss, which is hacked away to long-on
pitched up on off, blocked in front of the bowler. Looked like a slower one
shortish and on off, he rides it in front of point
pitched up on off, driven to long-off

Pollard pulls off the finger-on-the lips celebration. No tape-on-the-mouth act here. This was fuller and outside off, change-up. Reddy reaches out and slices it in the air. Vinay pedals back from backward point, loses his balance; manages to hang onto the catch even as short third man was converging. Oh wait, has Pollard overstepped? This is close.. Does he have some particle of his heel behind the crease? Given Out, he may have got some part of it behind the line. This is a terminal slide for the hosts..
back of a length and on off, he looks to force it away. Only manages an inside edge between Parthiv and short fine leg. Narrowly missed the leg stump
back of a length and on middle, Karn opens his bat face and steers it to short third man
full on middle and leg, clipped away backward of square leg
shortish and outside off, slapped to the off-side sweeper
Bang! first six of the night. Fuller and outside off, he slog-sweeps and sends it clattering several rows over midwicket. Huggggeee six. Caught in the crowd..
shortish on middle and leg, tucking up Karn for room. Jabbed past midwicket
slid through on off, turned behind square leg
quicker and outside off, down the track and punched to the covers
length on off, some turn as well. Dabbed in front of midwicket for one
another full toss on the leg stump, Reddy can do nothing but bunt it to short midwicket
mighty full on middle, squirted to short midwicket off the inner part of the bat
slowy full toss, dips in late, pushed past the covers
yorker outside off, jammed out behind point. The fielder moves across, but is lazy to put in the dive. Easy single
bouncer on off, semi-paddled and semi-pulled behind square leg
low full toss on the pads, helped away behind square leg
tossed up on middle, driven back at the bowler. Harbhajan misfields and gives away a single
back of a length and outside off, punched to Mitch Mc at sweeper cover
flat on off, pressed into the covers
offbreak on off, defended off the back foot
punched past the covers

chopped on! Harbhajan gets Rahul.. Flatter and outside off, spins in with excess bounce. Rahul steps away and looks to crash it through the covers with a cut. He ends up dragging it onto the off stump off an inner edge
pushed through quicker, Karn loads up for a big slogg-sweep but has to settle with an inside edge that wanders away to short fine leg
slides on with the arm outside off, dinked to short third
on a length and on off, Rahul backs away and slaps it over vacant mid-off. There is protection in the deep
darted short on middle, he rocks back and pulls it over midwicket
pushed through outside off, flicked to long-on
down the track, beaten in flight. Almost chipped back to the bowler
Harbhajan gives this ample air outside off, pressed in front of point
shortish and just outside off, he rocks back and short-arm pulls it to long-on
fullish and outside off, Karn reaches out and carves it over backward point
extra bounce and loop. Grips in the surface and turns away past the outer edge
flighted on middle and leg, nudged behind square on the leg side
pushed through outside off and spins away, cracked behind point
looped up and outside off, down the track and pushed back to the bowler
darted flat on middle, whipped through midwicket
pushed through flat and quick on the stumps, punched to long-on
Ojha out. twin strike! This was lobbed up on off, Suchith held this one back further. Chipped into the hands of cover after lazily pressing forward. How soft was that?
got'em! SRH further. Henriques makes a trip down the track, Suchith tossed it up wide outside off. Henriques can't slap it away, runs past it and Parthiv whips the bails off in a flash
pushed through on leg stump, he steps away and pushes it down to long-off
shortish and outside off, Rahul flashes a cut to the right of Suchith at deep third man
back of a length on the hips, tucked away past midwicket
charming stroke! Skims away to the boundary, one-bounce four. Rahul takes a step forward, backs away and caresses it inside out over mid-off, who was inside the circle
short, bumpy ball. Sails outside off to Parthiv. Rahul dropped his wrists on it. Too high and wide called
tucked up for room is Rahul, pushed back to Pandya
too full and straight, Rahul leans across and clips it neatly past midwicket
shortish and down leg, he can't meet with the pull. Wide called
back of a length on off, Rahul seeks to cut and chops it in front of backward point. The pair ponder over a single before deciding against it. They did not want to take on Pollard's arm
Rahul ventures down the track, does not get close to the pitch of this flighted ball and chips it to the left of Suchith, to mid-off
quick on the pads, arm-ball. He misses the flick, but this hardly threatened the stumps
flicked from an off-stump line through vacant midwicket
he comes down the track. Suchith pulls his length back, punched back at the bowler
fullish and on off, he skips down the track again. This time he works it gently to mid-on
slid through outside off, Rahul advances and looks to go over the covers. He ends up slicing it up and over backward point
Rahul fillets the gap. On a length and outside off, he opens his bat face and glides it in the gap between Parthiv and short third man. Smartly done. No power, just soft hands...
back of a length and around off, Rahul gets into a tangle as he seeks to flick. Gets a leading edge that pops in front of short third man
fuller length on off, patted past the outstretched left hand of Vinay to mid-off
Henriques takes a couple of paces forward, Vinay shortens his length on off, punched to the left of the bowler, towards long-off for a single
pitched up and attacking the off stump, pushed defensively to the covers off the back foot
length ball outside off, Rahul rides it down to third man again
back of a length and just a shade outside off, Rahul stays back, runs it past the two-man slip cordon with soft hands
drifts on the pads, he misses the flick but they sneak a leg bye

almost another wicket! On a back of a length and outside off, generates extra bounce. Henriques pushes at it, all he manages is a thick outside edge that flies away to the right of Harbhajan at a wideish slip position

Mitch Mc strikes again! He wears a giant smile on his face. The short ball reaps reward again. Here the line was outside off, Morgan looked to help it away with an upper cut, ends up carving it into the hands of Simmons at deep third man..
back of a length and zipping through the channel outside off, Morgan lets it be
tucked away off the hips to long leg
back of a length and on middle, dabbed off the back foot in front of point for one more
good length and outside off, Henriques takes a step forward and knocks it to mid-off for one
on a length and on middle, Morgan nurdles a single through midwicket
Morgan finds the escape route now. Stray ball on the pads, glanced away fine on the leg side, to the right of Parhiv
straighter in line, tucked to the left of short midwicket. Harbhajan gets across and deflects it towards mid-on
back of a length and outside off, extra bounce. The ball hits the bat as opposed to the bat hitting the ball. It rolls to the left of Vinay, towards mid-off
picked away off the pads to the right of midwicket
Morgan comes down the track and quietly taps this length ball to mid-on for one. Henriques reciprocated well
movement off the deck. Back of a length and swerves in, squirted to short fine leg off the inner part of the bat
back of a length and angled on off, he hangs back and dabs it to the covers with softish hands
sliding in on the pads, Moises Henqirues can't connect with the flick
and there is the sub-plot Amol was talking about. Shortish and outside off, Henriques chops it to Pollard at point
slinging in on the pads, tucked straight to midwicket. There was an escape route there, but Morgan had failed to put that away
Malinga belts out an lbw appeal, not given. This was a good inswinger from Malinga, Morgan is smacked on the front pad in front of leg. Snaking down leg
low full toss, swinging away. He does not nail the yorker. Bunted to the left of mid-off
slowish full ball on middle, Henriques thrusts his front pad across and pats it to leg
on a length, away-going ball, blocked in front of the covers
low full toss, dips in on middle, pushed defensively back to the bowler
veering down leg, Malinga strays in line. Henriques tries to help it away but can't connect. Wide
teases Morgan outside off, he does not bite
back of a length, comes in with the angle. Narrowly shaved the off stump. Ignored again
on a length and he probes away outside off, left alone. Past the tram-line. Wide
dug in on a back of a length and outside off with some extra zip and bounce. Morgan tightens his technique and lets it pass
beaten again is Morgan. Teaser outside off, he is seduced into another lazy push. The ball zips past the outside edge
back of a length outside off with some away movement, Morgan pokes and misses

Warner gone now! Mitch bangs in well-directed short ball on the stumps, hurries Warner for the pull. He skews it in the air off a fat top edge. Parthiv, slip and Pollard converged. The West Indian came forward from point and snaffled it. 7 for 2. The bowler roars and slams the turf before getting mobbed. Massive, massive wicket
The off stump is splintered. Malinga special!. He slings in a yorker, Dhawan stays back, seeks to squeeze it out, but can't do so. First pin down for the hosts..Beaten for pace was Dhawan
slowy fullish ball on off, pushed to mid-off. Warner can't manufacture his own pace
change-up, length and outside off, punched to cover-point
Malinga tests Warner with another short ball. He rocks back and pulls it behind square leg. Warner could execute it to perfection even in his sleep
full and swerving in on the pads, picked away to long leg
banged in shortish and rises, Warner arches his back and steers it deftly to third man
Mumbai Indians take the No.2 spot! They will face CSK in the qualifier. Parthiv rocks back, fetches this from outside off and short-arm pulls to mid-on
googly outside off, dabbed past a diving first slip to short third man
full and on off, right in Rohit's hitting zone. He sinks to one knee and pastes a slog-sweep over long-on. Gets off the mark in style
no fifty for Simmons. Consolatory wicket for SRH. Pushed through outside off, he backs away and attempts a cut only to slice it straight down the throat of Dhawan at point
fifty for Parthiv. Flatter and outside off, chopped through cover-point
Simmons backs away, Bhuvneshwar nails a yorker, right in the blockhole. The former jabs his bat down and keeps it out
fired full on off, he steps away and crashes it past the covers. Sweeper cover hunts it down
Simmons makes room outside leg, the bowler follows him. He manages a toe-ends it, the ball rolls back to Ojha
on a length and on off, dabbed to point with an open face
lifter from Bhuvneshwar, Simmons half-ducks out of the way
low full toss, tucked around the corner on the leg side
another short one, dispatched again. Simmons marmalises a flattish six over deep midwicket with a slog-sweep
smashed! Half-tracker from Karn, Simmons rocks back and muscles a pull over midwicket
full on middle, whippily driven to long-on
legbreak outside off, dabbed fine on the off side. Short third man had no chance again
fuller and on middle, he employs a reverse-sweep and beats short third man. Good connection from Parthiv
looks like a googly, punched down to long-on
slower ball on off, Simmons manipulates it behind square on leg side
back of a length and comes in on off, pushed back to the bowler
Simmons dances down the track, Henriques bangs a bouncer at 141ks, the ball sails over Simmon's shoulder to the keeper
on a length and outside off, Parthiv camps back and steers it to third man
pitched up and outside off, drilled to the covers. Dhawan makes a diving save
short and wide outside off, slapped to the covers
slapped fiercely! Parthiv nips down the track, the bowler shortens his length, slowy in pace as well. Flat-batted through mid-off
flat and width on offer as well, cut to backward point. The fielder fumbles and gifts Mumbai Indians
straight roller, defended
darted outside off, he misses the sweep. Ojha is beaten as well
looped up and spins away outside off, googly drags Parthiv forward, he loses his balance and falls over as he misses the flick. Ojha fluffs a stumping chance
worked through midwicket
flatter and outside off, Simmons rocks back and executes a cut behind point. Beats the fielder, short third man is also beaten
full and outside off, Parthiv drives it hard off the front foot, it just lands in front of one of the two fielders. Karn the man there
bouncer on off, Simmons aims to pull, mishits it behind square on the leg side
poor line, fired down leg. Poor length to boot as this was short. Wide called
on a length and on middle, punched down to mid-on. They hesitate for a brief while before completing the single
banged in short on off, Simmons hangs back and drags a pull through backward square leg
length and outside off, chipped in the gap at the covers
pitched up and outside off, Parthiv throws his bat at it, gets a thick outside edge to the left of Ojha, who was flying to his left
back of a length on off, too close to cut. Yet Parthiv goes through with the shot. Chopped in front of the covers
length on off, clipped to long-on for a jogged single
Parthiv opens the face of his bat on impact with this full offering outside off and dabs it behind point
pitched up and curling away outside off, mistimed drive to mid-off
shortish and outside off, sat up to be hit. Flayed to sweeper cover
too full and straight, Parthiv wrists it fine on the leg side. Gorgeous timing
Simmons wants two and hares back. Tickled off the pads, fine on the leg side
Parthiv fetches this from outside off and swat-pulls it to deep midwicket
big lifter from PK, beats Parthiv on the hook. Wide called for height

short of length on middle, down the track and dragged over midwicket. Parthiv bisects Rahul and Warner in the deep. The ball goes to the cow-corner boundary. Rahul did put in a dive, but PK isn't pleased
full on off, he shuffles across off and milks a single behind square on the leg side
slower ball on off, Simmons waits on it and pats it to leg. Parthiv wants a single but is sent back
too full and straight, Simmons should have picked that away. Misses out on the flick off the back foot
back of a length and on middle and leg. Parthiv is cramped for room. He defends it awkwardly
veering onto the hips, Simmons can't help it on its way. Off the pad for a leg bye. He may have got an inside edge on that
full and outside off, mishit drive to mid-off
length ball on off, slower in pace. Pushed back to the bowler off the inner part of the bat. Simmons was early into the shot
Simmons flits around in the crease. Too full and outside off, Simmons adjusts and squeezes it to short third man with an angled bat
low full toss, dips in on off. Pushed to mid-on
pitched up and outside off from round the stumps, sliced towards cover point
on a length and outside off, punched to the covers
on a length and outside off, Parthiv loads up for an off-drive, gets an inner edge to leg
PK's line is haywire. Sliding down leg, wide called
picked away off the pads to long leg
straying onto the pads, twirl of the wrists as Simmons puts it away behind square on the leg side with a flick
swinging in on the pads, Simmons does not get hold of the glance, rolls off the pad to the keeper
too full on the pads and swinging in, Parthiv stays back and flicks it off his pads with the swing, through the midwicket region for a four!
bouncer on the leg stump and Parthiv ducks under it
width on offer outside off, Parthiv throws his bat at it cuts the ball between cover point and point for four without moving his feet much
well outside off with some shape, helped to third man for one easily
away-swinging yorker well outside off, Simmons gets a bottom edge to the keeper
bit of inside edge as Parthiv looks to push the outswinger towards the off side, but gets a single on leg after the edge
on the stumps now, worked off the pads to deep midwicket for one
bit too short, Simmons hardly moves his feet, only turns on the back foot, and swivels his bat in the ball's direction to pull it for four past short fine leg
bit of width outside off, Parthiv runs it down to third man for one
closer to off stump now, Simmons defends it gently towards mid-off and takes off for one
Simmons connects against Steyn and drills one for four! He charged down the track with some room and swung his arms to crunch that outswinger all along the ground through the covers
bit too full on the pads, Parthiv drives it just wide of mid-on for one more
swings it from length towards middle stumps, Parthiv defends it softly to cover and takes a very quick single
well outside off with hardly any swing, guides it to third man for one
not much swing this time, not much room either and it's pushed towards point
banana inswing from outside off, Simmons covers his stumps and defends it back
swings it the other way this time, but down the leg side for a wide
back of length and swinging away again, driven off the back foot to cover
shapes it away nicely just a bit from outside off, pushed down to mid-off
and again! Pitched up and outside off, Parthiv is dragged into a drive and is beaten again
belated appeal for caught behind. Not given. On a length and nips away off the seam, shaves past the groping bat of Parthiv
fullish on off, forward and pushed to mid-off
fuller and width on offer. Parthiv chases it and plays a flash drive through cover-point
good length with some away movement, tapped in front of mid-off
beautiful outswinger outside off, drags Simmons into a feeble push. Beaten emphatically
